messages:
maria: Quick sync — final pass needed on landing copy for Hosted API / Dedicated / Private before the launch posts + webinar promos. Goal: unified positioning but distinct CTAs per mode. Can we lock hero + 2 supporting lines by EOD?

jake: I can push a pass. thinking: keep hero focused on outcomes (predictable inference) and use subheads for mode details. have 3 headline options in the doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx (pls comment) :eyes:

sophia: For Dedicated, highlight predictable throughput and reserved capacity. For Private, highlight VPC/on-prem + compliance hooks. For Hosted, emphasize fast time-to-value and free credits. Short bullets under each mode work better than long paragraphs.

liam: For webinar landing and launch posts we should bake in benchmark callouts — e.g., 2x lower tail latency vs standard endpoints on our test suite, and a sample cost-per-1k-req figure. @jake can you confirm numbers with eng-rt?

maria: @liam yes — we should avoid raw numbers on the public homepage, but include a benchmark snapshot in the launch post and webinar slides. Homepage can say "industry-leading latency & predictable unit economics" and link to benchmark page.

jake: Eng-rt gave provisional stats: 95th pctl latency 140ms on medium seq, cost guidance down 30% with batching + cache. I'll add a short callout in the benchmark doc.

olivia: Quick note on CTAs — propose: Hosted -> "Get started (free)"; Dedicated -> "Contact sales for reserved capacity"; Private -> "Request private deployment". Keep all CTAs visually similar but with microcopy differences (free vs sales vs request). :white_check_mark:

sophia: Also suggest we add a small line under each CTA about expected time to value: Hosted (minutes), Dedicated (weeks), Private (depends). Helps set expectations and reduce support tickets.

maria: Love that. For the hero variants Jake shared, which one performs better for webinar signups? We need to pick the hero that drives demo + signups, not just awareness.

jake: My bet is Variant B (outcome-led: "Predictable LLM inference, everywhere") — runs well in 2 quick headline tests we did internally. I'll queue a 2-day feature flag A/B to measure CTR on homepage hero for the next sprint. Code snippet for flagging: 
```
feature_flag: hero_ab_test
variants: [A, B]
duration: 48h
```

maria: Perfect. Marketing calendar: deploy post + benchmark writeup Tue, webinar pre-announce Thu, main webinar next Wed. @deploy-bot can you reserve the 10am promo slot on Thu?

deploy-bot: reminder: calendar slot requested — marketing-promo-10am-1727840000. Status: tentatively booked.

liam: On inbound routing — once someone signs up via webinar landing we need to route to the right funnel: Hosted leads -> trial nurture; Dedicated -> AE handoff; Private -> technical solutions engineer. Can ops add hidden field on form with selected mode?

jake: yes, form will include a hidden `deployment_mode` param and we will map to SFDC lead queues accordingly. I'll attach the mapping table to the doc.

olivia: For launch social posts: shorter, punchy claim + link to benchmark blog. For LinkedIn long form, expand on the Dedicated use case with a customer vignette. For X/Twitter, use 2 quick stats and the webinar CTA. I'll write drafts tonight.

sophia: One more thing — accessibility & SEO: make sure hero H1 contains primary keyword "LLM inference" and the meta description mentions "hosted, dedicated, private". SEO owner will review tomorrow.

maria: Action items: Jake finalize hero variants + A/B flag (owner), Olivia draft social + webinar copy (owner), Liam confirm benchmark numbers and slides (owner), Sophia finalize microcopy & SEO checks, Maria will review and lock hero by EOD. Thanks team. :rocket:
